annual_return_watch.why: The annual return is the only deadline whose amount is not known until the year is nearly over, which is what makes an in-year projection worth having at all.
annual_return_watch.raise_when: outlook.configured is true and outlook.shortfall is material — that is tax owed beyond everything already withheld and advanced. Raise it while advances can still be adjusted, not in June.
annual_return_watch.if_not_configured: outlook.configured false means the declared side (salary, miluim, withholding, deposits, advances) was never entered. Ask for the year's Form 106 and certificates; do not report a balance.
